svg.title: VCSEL power levels and modulation response
svg.desc: (a) Transmitted optical power over 24 symbols with the four levels P0 to P3 (0.57 to 1.43 mW); the transitions are rounded and overshoot slightly because of the VCSEL bandwidth. (b) Magnitude of the second-order response, -3 dB at 28.3 GHz.
